The '''Orma''' was one of the four [[akia]]s of [[Aramandi]] society. They were based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aram]], and were the first akia to colonize another [[Star system/Legends|star system]], the [[Orma system/Legends|Orma system]].<ref name="FBS" />

The Orma were the most devout followers of the [[Eeronon]]. They were the most peaceful akia, preferring to settle disputes through mediation or by religious observance. As a result of their religious devotion, the akia were the least tolerant of off-worlders. They dressed in plain brown clothes with a single amulet worn around the neck.<ref name="FBS" />
